_what: PLACES WORTH BAKING A ROUTE TO THAT ARE NOT EXITS. The bake plans between exit anchors, because crossing a room is what a journey needs. Working INSIDE a room needs the other thing: routes to the squares the work is at. These are declared rather than derived because the map file does not carry them - a spawn point lives in the .kod, not in the .roo - and because which squares are worth a route is a judgement, not a fact about the geometry.
_coordinates: row,col in KOD 1-BASED SQUARES, the same space exitAnchors emits and the same space walk_to takes. Not fine units, not 0-based.
_how: node tools/m59-routebake.mjs --rooms <n>   (it adopts every other room from the table on disk and refuses to write a hole)

2154._source: plGenerators in kod/object/active/holder/room/monsroom/kcforest/ke4.kod (Constructed), read 2026-10-29 at Meridian59 fe93b6c6. Eleven generators, [row,col] per monsroom.kod:218-219; avars, chieftains and shamans 40/35/25, capped at 12. The mana node appears at NODE_ROW/NODE_COL 34,52.
2154._why: The room has ONE exit (west edge, r16c1, to 2144) and so had ZERO baked routes: a one-exit room has no exit pairs, and the bake only planned between exits. Every walk to or from a generator was planned live on the coarse grid, and this room's obstacles are sector-height ledges rather than full-height walls: of 752 neighbouring standable pairs the mover refuses in at least one direction, 617 have floors more than 384 client units apart (measured 2026-10-29). 2026-10-29 village run: 15 jams of 5-34 s at the neck c7-12 in front of the door. Declared, every generator has a baked route from the door and one back (24 routes, 0 unproved pivot legs); the two directions differ because a ledge you drop off is not one you climb. Generator-to-generator is baked too except five pairs the BFS reaches but cannot spell on the mover (53,46/53,56/46,66/33,71 -> 22,67 and 70,20 -> 14,25); for those railAcross boards whichever other head has a line to the target.
